headline: Executive order expands US sanctions on Iran to cover more parts of its economy.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Trump, lets the US government impose sanctions on more sectors, or industries, of Iran's economy than before. The title does not say which sectors are covered or exactly what penalties apply. Sanctions like these usually block people and companies from doing business with those targeted.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses working in the targeted sectors of Iran's economy
who_it_affects.how: They may face US sanctions under this order.

who_it_affects.group: US and foreign companies that trade with Iran
who_it_affects.how: They may face new limits or penalties for doing business in the targeted Iranian sectors.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 10, 2020; the source does not state a separate start date.
